subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

Most of the flowers __bloom__ in the spring season but they start to _______ during summer.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"wither"** means to become dry and shriveled, typically due to lack of water; to fade away or decay. (मुरझाना)

 
 
• **Example: **Without proper care, the plants in the garden began to** wither.**
 
 
 
• **"Bloom" **refers to the state or period of flowering; to produce flowers. (खिलना)
 
 
• **Example: **The cherry trees **bloom** beautifully in the spring.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'bloom' **is **'wither'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flush **(लालिमा आना): To become red and hot, typically as the result of illness or strong emotion.

 
 
• **Example:** His cheeks flush with embarrassment when he realized his mistake.
 
 
 
• **Flourish **(फलना-फूलना): To grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way.
 
 
• **Example: **The small business began to flourish after they implemented new marketing strategies.
 
 
 
• **Blossom** (फूलना): To produce flowers or to develop in a promising or healthy way.
 
 
• **Example:** The apple trees are expected to blossom in the next few weeks.
